outcome: Postpartum preeclampsia (categorized as no PE, antepartum/intrapartum PE, and late PPPE)
cohort: Women who delivered at a safety-net hospital in Atlanta, Georgia, between July 1, 2016 and June 30, 2018
finding: Maternal obesity and gestational hypertension were uniquely associated with late postpartum preeclampsia, while multifetal gestations and cesarean delivery were associated with both PPPE and antepartum/intrapartum preeclampsia.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was associated with both late postpartum preeclampsia and antepartum/intrapartum preeclampsia, with a stronger association for late postpartum preeclampsia.
